scripts.build: npm run build:pkg && node scripts/build-info.ts && node scripts/clean.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.sw.json && node scripts/vendor.ts && node scripts/copy-static.ts && node scripts/precache.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:pkg && node scripts/build-info.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.check.json
scripts.test: npm run build:pkg && node scripts/build-info.ts && node --test tests/*.test.ts && npm test --workspaces
scripts.dev: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8080 -d dist
scripts.dev:ai: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788
